snippet.title: Nightmare Circus Gameplay Trailer | Gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm.
As a member of a wandering circus troupe, you suddenly find yourself lost in an unknown land. You must fight enemies that wander the area, save your fellow troupe members who are also stuck within this realm, uncover the mysteries of the realm, and make it back to the real world.

Fight like a Puppeteer! 
The key feature in Nightmare Circus is the “Puppet String” mechanic. The player can use the puppeteer’s sticks as a weapon, alongside a Control Bar as a bat to fend off hostile enemies, as well as to traverse, manoeuvre, and attack with our unique Collision Combat system. 
Master the strings in dozens of different ways to gain the upper hand and defeat your enemies. Whether you decide to use the environment to your advantage and experience the physics behind the Collision Combat system by slamming enemies into hard-hitting objects or wrap and tie your enemies together to stun them and begin a combo by mixing all the possibilities offered by the Puppet Strings.

Use a powerful slingshot to launch yourself at the monsters, hook foes to each other, and enjoy the vast array of combo mechanics that let you mix and match your offensive options with style. Choose from three unique Control Bars, each offering a different combat style to combine light but swift attack, long-reaching medium attack, and bashing strike from heavy attacks into devastating combo sequences. 
That’s what makes the Collision Combat system unique, with dozens of gameplay options.

Nightmare Circus, coming 2026 to PC, Xbox, PS5, and Nintendo Switch 2
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227900/Nightmare_Circus/
